summary: Tested Distributor→Factory Stock Returns Zoho invoice-adjustment flow end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 12/13 pytest tests PASSED (1 skipped: no unsettled deliveries in prior month for the settlement-create path). All stock-in-options / warehouse-source guardrails / confirm auto-adjust / retry endpoint / settlement preview-and-create exclusion / detach-factory-returns paths behave as specified. Frontend: DeliveriesTab New Factory Return dialog exposes factory-stockin-select + amber banner referencing 'credit note applied to the selected Stock-In invoice'; the factory returns table shows the red 'Adjust invoice' pill with data-testid adjust-invoice-{id}; the adjust-invoice-dialog opens with the Stock-In select, the previous failure message ('Stock-In SHP-2026-0052 has no Zoho invoice to adjust against') and a Create Credit Note button (data-testid adjust-invoice-confirm). Zoho-not-configured graceful failure works exactly as per acceptance criteria.
critical_code_review_comments: distributors.py has grown to 10674 lines — should be split into settlement/monthly-reconciliation submodules for maintainability.
adjust_factory_return_invoice endpoint accepts an untyped `dict = None` body; consider a Pydantic model (AdjustInvoiceRequest {stock_in_shipment_id: Optional[str]}) for consistency.

In factory_returns.confirm_factory_return, the invoice_adjustment retry path is fine, but confirm auto-runs even when there's no chance of success (e.g., no Zoho mapping). The 'failed' record with a clear error is intentional per spec — but logging the failure at WARN would help ops.
detach-factory-returns audit fields are stored on the settlement doc but there is no separate audit collection entry — acceptable for MVP; consider distributor_settlement_events for full trail.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/13 passed, 1 skipped for lack of period data)
